seo.metaTitle: PDF page to image converter — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Rasterize document pages into high-resolution 300 DPI or 600 DPI PNG/JPEG images locally in your browser. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-image-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: PDF page to image converter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-image-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does PDF page to image converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. PDF page to image converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-image-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate PDF page to image converter?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_to_image.json or open /tools/pdf-to-image?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
